points.name: Threshold / Secular Exit
points.question: Departure, doubt, humanism and autonomy are distinct from the dwarfs' fictional disillusionment.

points.name: Judaism
points.question: Covenant, interpretation, communal memory and living disagreement; no single Jewish voice.

points.name: Islam
points.question: Tawhid, prophethood, mercy and accountability; do not merge Jesus and Muhammad into one role.

points.name: Tash · fictional
points.question: Lewis's Calormene fiction and political manipulation of sacred authority; not a proxy for Islam.

points.name: Aslan · fictional
points.question: The lion as a narrative figure of self-offering and discernment; Leo is an astronomical lion, not proof of identity.

points.name: Christianity
points.question: Incarnation, death, resurrection and human solidarity; distinguish theology from Narnian analogy.

points.name: Zoroastrianism / Ahura Mazda
points.question: Asha, good thought, beneficial action, cosmic renewal and freely chosen truth; not simply Christian or Islamic anticipation.
